exact_failure.predicate: one continuation per logical episode is allowed in each job
exact_failure.processor_mapping: codex_mem/episode_processor.py:942-944 maps ValueError/TypeError/KeyError/JevQualityError to invalid_response; whole batch quarantined.
exact_failure.critical_distinction: Both episodes REQUEST the same target. Each alone is accepted as a standalone episode with omitted_continuities_count=1. The replay does NOT demonstrate two supported successor edges. continued_roots is reserved before continuity support is checked, so even the first unproved/omitted continuation blocks the second.
exact_failure.native_contract_gap: Each array item may independently select any disclosed current head. No cross-item unique-target/logical-root rule is represented in native schema; prompt does not explicitly state one successor per logical root per job.
exact_failure.earlier_boundary_results: Raw receipt, object ownership, exact refs/quotes and canonical schema/span validation all pass.

ranked_falsifiable_hypotheses.result: Confirmed exact trigger; not evidence that both requested continuations were valid.

minimization.counterfactual_policy: No minimized or accepted variant was committed, persisted as model output, graded, or substituted into trial.

pipeline_failures_field.current_contract: A projection of noncomplete existing consolidation receipts, primary generation receipts only in independent-generation mode, and included regeneration pipeline receipts. Not a universal error/event/driver-stop list.
pipeline_failures_field.why_h05_absent: shared-prefix mode leaves primary generation_receipts empty. h05 consolidation.json is absent after driver skip; missing primary consolidation is synthesized only for independent-generation. Thus neither the failed shared generation nor the skipped clone/consolidation enters this list.
pipeline_failures_field.why_h12_absent: Native ledger failed call and driver unknown_usage_stop are not inputs to this list; no h12 consolidation file exists. Usage records failed_calls=1, unknown count=1 and tokens=null correctly.
pipeline_failures_field.driver_evidence: run-experiment.py:248-260 records h05 pipeline_failure_no_retry; 278-286 skips invalid prefix phases. 290-299 records driver_stopped and attempts report; execute checks unknown usage before nonzero subprocess exit, so h12 stop journal says unknown_usage_stop.
pipeline_failures_field.classification: Observability scope gap if interpreted as all pipeline failures, not an incorrect complete/pass decision or absent failed usage. Existing broad field name does not convey its restricted projection. No report change requested/applied.
pipeline_failures_field.prospective_recommendation: Include shared-prefix generation outcomes and explicit unstarted/skipped/driver-stop/native-failure categories in a separately versioned comprehensive pipeline summary, or name/document present narrow scope. Keep missing216 denominator, distinct stage statuses and unknown cost; avoid duplicating calls/tokens.

prospective_minimal_general_repair.primary: Reserve/check continued_roots only for validated supported successor edges. An unproved continuity already follows the conservative standalone-plus-omission path and should not consume a root slot. Preserve strict rejection of two supported continuations of one logical episode and of continuation/consolidation root overlap. No selection of a winning duplicate, no model-output merging or synthesizing a claim.
prospective_minimal_general_repair.native_boundary: State one supported successor per logical root per job explicitly. An earlier duplicate-request reject alone improves diagnosis but does not remove the observed schema/runtime mismatch. A future structural native contract can expose one optional continuation slot per disclosed head, with a distinct standalone list, if preventing representable duplicate targets is required; version it explicitly. Do not globally cap episodes to one.
tests_required_before_implementation: Two unproved same-head continuations become separate standalone records with two explicit continuity omissions; prior head unchanged.
Two supported same-root successors reject the entire batch, no objects/evidence/events partially committed.
A supported plus unproved same-root request produces only the supported successor; test both array orders.
Distinct supported logical roots succeed; aliases/current heads sharing a logical root still reject.
Continuation versus consolidation root overlap remains rejected in either order.
Unknown head, unknown refs, foreign project/scope and malformed native layout remain rejected.
Native-schema/request version and canonical Store/API compatibility pinned; no old receipt reprocessing.
prospective_minimal_general_repair.semantic_limit: Structural and deterministic provenance checks do not establish semantic truth or guarantee model extraction quality.
prospective_minimal_general_repair.historical_policy: No replay/retry/repair/rescore of h05/h12 or any closed trial. Prospective source revision only after parent source hold release/review.

limits: No source fixes or acceptance tests implemented. Diagnosis artifacts only.
